title: Localizing and Correcting Errors for LLM-based Planners
abstract: arXiv:2602.00276v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong reasoning capabilities on math and coding, but frequently fail on symbolic classical planning tasks. Our studies, as well as prior work, show that LLM-generated plans routinely violate domain constraints given in their instructions (e.g., walking through walls). To address this failure, we propose iteratively augmenting instructions with Localized In-Context Learning (L-ICL) demonstrations: targeted corrections for specific failing steps. Specifically, L-ICL identifies the first constraint violation in a trace and injects a minimal input-output example giving the correct behavior for the failing step. Our proposed technique of L-ICL is much effective than explicit instructions or traditional ICL, which adds complete problem-solving trajectories, and many other baselines. translated_title: 基于大语言模型的规划器的错误定位与纠正
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）在数学和编程任务上展现出强大的推理能力，但在符号化经典规划任务上经常失败。我们的研究以及先前的工作表明，LLM生成的计划经常违反指令中给出的领域约束（例如，穿过墙壁）。为了解决这一问题，我们提出通过定位化上下文学习（L-ICL）演示来迭代增强指令，即针对特定失败步骤提供定向纠正。具体而言，L-ICL识别执行轨迹中的第一个约束违反，并注入一个最小的输入-输出示例，为失败步骤给出正确的行为方式。我们提出的L-ICL技术比显式指令或传统的ICL（后者添加完整的问题求解轨迹）以及许多其他基线方法有效得多。例如，在8x8网格世界中，L-ICL仅使用60个训练示例就能以89%的概率生成有效计划。
tldr: 本文提出定位化上下文学习（L-ICL）方法，通过识别LLM生成计划中的首个约束违反并注入针对失败步骤的最小纠正示例来迭代增强指令，使LLM在8x8网格世界任务上仅用60个训练示例就以89%的概率生成有效计划。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Localized In-Context Learning (L-ICL), which iteratively augments LLM planner instructions by identifying the first constraint violation in a plan and injecting minimal corrective demonstrations for the failing steps, achieving 89% valid plans on an 8x8 gridworld with only 60 training examples.
